title: Add onboarding checklist snippet generator + safe streaming helpers
text:
Add onboarding checklist snippet generator + safe streaming helpers

body:
Context: As part of the Guided Onboarding + “First production launch” checklist effort, we want the TypeScript SDK docs and copy/pastable snippets to map 1:1 to checklist steps (API key setup, first request, streaming, retries/timeouts, quotas/budgets pointers, model pinning, and basic observability hooks). This PR adds a small snippet generation pipeline so Console/docs can link to stable, versioned snippets, and introduces helper methods for safe streaming usage (disconnect handling + abort/timeouts) with production-friendly defaults.

What’s included: (1) Snippet generator: Adds scripts/generate-checklist-snippets.ts that produces language-consistent snippets under docs/snippets/checklist/*.md from a single source-of-truth template (src/snippets/checklist.ts). Snippets are grouped by checklist step and include short “why this matters” blurbs aligned to Console step copy length constraints. (2) Production defaults helper: Adds RedwoodClient.withProductionDefaults({...}) convenience constructor which configures recommended timeouts, retry/backoff for retryable status codes (429/5xx), and idempotency key generation for non-streaming requests. Defaults are documented and can be overridden. (3) Safe streaming helpers: Adds streamChatSafe() wrapper for SSE streaming that handles: AbortController cancellation, configurable idle timeout, retry on transient disconnects with max attempts, and an onReconnect callback for logging/metrics. This is intentionally conservative (we don’t attempt to resume mid-stream; we re-issue the request with the same messages when safe). (4) Docs updates: Updates README + docs/production-readiness.md + docs/onboarding-checklist.md to match checklist ordering and link to the generated snippets. Adds explicit guidance for common first-time issues we see in Support: 401/403 from wrong env var, “stream ends early” confusion, and 429 retry/backoff expectations.

Out of scope: Budget/quota configuration APIs (Console-only), and any client-side emission of onboarding events. This PR only updates code/docs/snippets; onboarding event emission is server-side (see gateway/control-plane work).

Testing: Unit tests added for retry classifier + streaming idle timeout behavior. Manual test run against staging: created client from snippet, verified: first request succeeds, streaming outputs tokens, forced network drop triggers retry, abort cancels stream.

Follow-ups: (a) update redwood-docs to consume generated snippet artifacts (tracked separately), (b) add an example app that mirrors the full “first production launch” flow (handled in examples repo).

conversation:
Monica Patel (review): Love the direction. Two asks before approval: (1) ensure retries are disabled by default for streaming unless the helper opts in (we don’t want silent replays), and (2) add explicit note in docs about non-resumable streams so users understand what happens on reconnect.
Dana Lo (author): Good call. Updated so RedwoodClient.withProductionDefaults only applies to non-streaming requests. streamChatSafe opts into retry explicitly and documents behavior (re-issues request, does not resume). Added doc callout + JSDoc.
Ibrahim Khan (review): streamChatSafe: can we guard against retrying on 4xx (except 429) and make idle timeout default to something reasonable? Also consider surfacing attempt count in callback.
Dana Lo (author): Updated classifier to retry only on 429 + 5xx + network errors. Default idle timeout set to 30s (configurable). onReconnect now receives { attempt, reason }. Added tests.
Brian Murphy (review): Snippet generator outputs look good. Minor: please keep env var name consistent with the rest of the SDK docs (REDWOOD_API_KEY) and avoid referencing internal base URLs in snippets.
Dana Lo (author): Fixed env var naming across templates. Snippets now use default client config and mention optional baseURL override only in advanced section.
Sabrina James (review): Docs are clearer now. One more suggestion: add a tiny example showing structured logging hooks for retries/reconnects (even if it’s just console.* in snippet).
Dana Lo (author): Added optional logger example in the retries/timeouts snippet (kept concise).
Monica Patel (review): Approved once CI is green.
CI Bot: All checks passed.
Monica Patel (review): Approved.
Ibrahim Khan (review): Approved.
Dana Lo (author): Merging (squash).
